challenge.method: Recompute queue-first selection on four symbolic messages, with a failed guard, two eligible clauses for one message and a later eligible message. Compare the no-match timeout and separate process signal-ordering passages.
challenge.results: The first eligible message reaches its first eligible clause. An earlier nonmatching entry and later matching entries remain in their previous order in this selection model. The cited order is received queue order. The same-sender signal guarantee and timeout do not broaden that order claim.

limitations: The proposition concerns an ordinary receive with a selectable entry. It leaves global ordering, wait and timeout behavior, queue optimizations, concurrency scheduling and selected-body effects outside scope.
